d: We are looking for an experienced and technically proficient Assistant Manager – External Audit to support the planning, execution, and delivery of external audit engagements.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in external auditing, with proven experience supervising audit teams, managing multiple engagements, maintaining client relationships, and ensuring audit quality and compliance with professional standards.
q: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field .
Minimum 6.5 years of relevant audit experience , preferably within an external audit or professional services environment.
Professional qualification such as ACCA, CPA, or CA is mandatory.
Strong technical knowledge of external auditing, financial reporting, audit procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Proven experience managing audit engagements, reviewing working papers, and supervising audit teams.
Experience in audit planning, risk assessment, engagement budgeting, and resource management.
Strong client relationship management, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, leadership, and decision-making abilities.
Ability to manage multiple engagements and deliver high-quality work within deadlines.
Proficiency in spoken and written Arabic and English is required.
Familiarity with CaseWare and audit documentation systems would be an advantage.
r: li
Plan, coordinate, and supervise external audit engagements, ensuring timely completion and high-quality deliverables.
li
Develop audit plans, engagement budgets, risk assessments, and appropriate audit procedures.
li
Review audit working papers, supporting evidence, and audit documentation to ensure accuracy and compliance with applicable standards.
li
Supervise multiple audit engagements simultaneously, ensuring effective resource allocation and adherence to deadlines.
li
Review audit findings, identify accounting and audit-related issues, and recommend appropriate solutions.
li
Build and maintain professional relationships with clients, ensuring effective communication and timely resolution of engagement matters.
li
Monitor engagement budgets, staff utilization, billing, and overall engagement efficiency.
li
Lead, guide, and mentor audit team members, providing technical support, performance feedback, and development opportunities.
li
Ensure compliance with audit methodologies, professional standards, local regulations, and internal quality requirements.
li
Oversee the timely completion, documentation, and archiving of audit files, including CaseWare requirements.
li
Coordinate with senior management on engagement progress, client requirements, and key audit matters.
li
Identify opportunities to strengthen client relationships and support the development of the firm's service offerings.

d: Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
The Executive Assistant will provide high-quality executive, operational, and

administrative support to senior leaders based in Dubai. Acting as a trusted partner, the role will help leaders manage competing priorities, maintain an effective operating rhythm, and coordinate engagement across CEMEA markets and global teams.

This role requires exceptional judgment, discretion, organizational discipline, and the ability to operate confidently in a fast-paced, multicultural, and highly matrixed environment. The successful candidate will anticipate business needs, facilitate timely decision-making, and use digital and AI-enabled tools to improve executive and team effectiveness.
q: Minimum 7 years of experience in an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Business Operations, or similar support role, preferably within a multinational or highly matrixed organization.
Proven experience supporting Vice President-level or other senior leaders in a fast-paced and complex environment.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex calendars, international travel, multiple priorities, and competing deadlines.
Strong organizational, prioritization, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
Proven ability to handle highly confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
Proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented, with strong judgment and the ability to anticipate business needs.
Experience coordinating across multiple countries, cultures, functions, and time zones.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trusted relationships across all levels of the organization.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and SharePoint.
Experience using AI-enabled productivity tools to support research, drafting, meeting preparation, workflow improvement, and collaboration.
Familiarity with travel, expense, procurement, budgeting, and supplier management systems.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience preferred.
Experience supporting teams within the CEMEA region is an advantage.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
